source: No maker manual. Read from the panels, the CHANGELOG.md shipped in the installed plugin (v2.4.23), the installed build, the port map we hand-read, and the community manual at https://github.com/patman023/nysthimanual, which is almost entirely empty. NYSTHI ships no presets and no demo patches.
verification: voltage ranges are not published for this plugin: no public source is available for verification. Corrections and citations are welcome from anyone with access to the source.
